Ready for Exam Conditions?

This simulation mirrors the CCM exam experience as closely as possible.

  • 180 questions drawn proportionally from all 6 domains
  • 3 hours total (180 minutes)
  • No rationale or feedback during the exam
  • Results and domain breakdown shown at the end
  • You may flag questions and return to them
⚠️ The CCMC does not publish a cut score. This platform does not declare pass or fail. Results are for self-assessment only.
